items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.summary: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

items.title: PhysicsWallah Q1 FY27 revenue jumps 24% to Rs 1,054 Cr amid Rs 88 Cr net loss
items.summary: PhysicsWallah’s Q1 FY27 revenue rose 24% to Rs 1,053.95 crore. While achieving positive EBITDA of Rs 52 crore, the group reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 88.28 crore.
